scope: Four assigned source/test paths; unaccepted source custody and safe file discovery
assessment: Successful workspace write acknowledgment now follows immutable candidate Git import and durable candidate-journal save. Existing repositoryGit uses core.fsync=all; fileState persists the source binding.

retain is independent of validation and acceptance. Exact source/tree/parent/invocation refs remain distinct from accepted source; recoverCandidate still requires exact retained revision, current accepted base, successful test/build validation and publication capability.

Exceptional close retains directly changed initialized workspace before deleting scratch. Lease, import, quota or persistence failure leaves scratch intact and releases the per-thread queue. No lost source is inferred accepted.
Discovery omits symbolic-link, oversized and absent sparse entries without following links. Direct read/write symlink and path rejection remains; 500 entries, file size and Git output bounds stay.
Existing storage/revision limits and failure fences remain; no model, payment or transaction journal recovery authority is derived from a retained candidate.

independentChecks.skips: Existing opt-in Docker cases were not executed.

limits: Actual local Git/filesystem and labelled validation fixtures. No native proof, model call, chain/service/cloud action or live artifact acceptance claimed.
